neet_phy_u13_t11_1.working: Bismuth is the classic diamagnetic material. Aluminium and sodium are paramagnetic, and nickel is ferromagnetic.

neet_phy_u13_t11_3.working: The level falls because the liquid is repelled from the strong-field region, so it is diamagnetic. Water is diamagnetic. Liquid O2, CuCl2 solution and Al are paramagnetic.

neet_phy_u13_t11_4.working: Superconductor: chi = -1 (perfect diamagnet). Copper: small negative chi. Aluminium: small positive chi. Iron: chi >> 1.

neet_phy_u13_t11_5.working: A is true. B is false (mu_r < 1). C is true. D is false (it aligns parallel). E is true (diamagnetic chi is nearly independent of temperature). So A, C and E are correct.
